messages:
Maya: Heads up — RiverPad onboarding hit intermittent auth failures on our init endpoint. They see 401 then immediate retry succeeds. Happening on their Node side only. Any quick triage tips?
Jorge: 401 -> signature/claims/clock skew. Ask for the exact Authorization header they sent (sanitized ok) and the Date header from client. Also grab X-Request-Id so we can find the server logs.
Maya: Got a sanitized curl from them:
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSU...\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/init
> Date: Sun, 13 Jul 2025 01:22:11 GMT
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{ \"error\": \"unauthorized\" }
```
They rotate ephemeral tokens every 60s with an internal agent.
Chad: Two likely culprits: (1) client clock drift causing `exp`/`nbf` fail, (2) JWKS/public-key cache lag when keys rotate. If they rotate < cache TTL we can see transient 401s until cache refresh.
Sam: Noted — our Node SDK v2.0.1 caches JWKS for 120s by default. If their key rotation period is 60s, that mismatch explains the behavior. Which SDK are they using?
Maya: They confirmed Node SDK v2.0.1.
Jorge: Ok. Also confirm their host NTP status. If `Date` header is off by >30s vs our server it will trigger token time checks.
Maya: I asked for `ntpstat` and logs. They replied their app host had drift ~45s and NTP wasn't running reliably.
Chad: Actionable: ask them to sync clock (`sudo ntpdate -u pool.ntp.org` or enable chrony). Meanwhile, best practice is to avoid rotating keys faster than your JWKS cache window, or make the SDK refreshable on rotation events.
Sam: We can add an opt-in \"soft retry\" for transient signature/401 when we detect an `x-key-rotated` hint or when response includes our `x-auth-reason=signature` header. Suggest a single retry with 100-300ms jitter. I'll prototype and run a small canary. We should be careful to not mask genuine credential errors.
maya: pinging customer to patch NTP and test.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: sdk@2.0.2-soft-retry to staging 2025-07-14T08:00Z :rocket:
Maya: Customer synced clocks and reported host now within 1s of NTP. They also upgraded to the staging SDK build; init succeeds consistently in our repro for 45m. No more random 401s. :white_check_mark:
Jorge: I'll add a short line in onboarding checklist and the KB: \"If using ephemeral key rotation <2m, ensure host clock is synced and coordinate JWKS propagation or SDK cache settings.\"
Maya: Closing on our side. Will reopen if it recurs. Thanks all.
